Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.</p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.
